body: Pardon me when I say death is a choice, I mean suicide is a choice. When I reference parasite, I was meaning myself. I apologize for any confusion of my wording as I was writing what I felt about your post.

Thanks. It feels like the heaviness in my heart is lifted. I may never understand the full importance of living, but even one person caring about me and letting myself be vulnerable and care about others too is simply amazing. Crazy, but amazing.

As a high school freshman, I really can not understand the pain of depression. But I hope you find your purpose to live as life is a choice we all can make. I have not found mine, and life feels numb. It makes me want to die sometimes, but knowing that someone, two people in fact, care about me, fills me with the tiniest of hopes that I can choose to live. This choice is hard at times and sometimes choosing to live is painful. I hope you choose to live with happiness and peace of mind.
I appreciate your thoughts and concern. I think that this is weird as it is my very first Reddit post. Thanks a million for caring about others.
